summary: openSIPS is a server application that handles Session Initiation Protocol traffic for routing voice, video, instant messaging, and presence data. It acts as a core networking component for managing real-time communication sessions across various SIP extensions.
goodFor: It is well-suited for systems administrators and telecommunications engineers building custom VoIP infrastructures or large-scale communication platforms.
watchOut: Configuring a SIP proxy requires deep domain knowledge of networking protocols, and improper setup can lead to security vulnerabilities or routing failures.
deployNotes: As a compiled C application, it typically requires careful dependency management on your host system and will usually need a backing database for persistent subscriber data or routing tables.
